answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk fake identities. A new identity posts a 20-coin bond. Each epoch, five random peers audit one filing each with a falcon-swift check. A failed filing loses 100 coins; a false pass costs the auditor 20. Auditors come from the whole ocean of agents, never one knoll of friends, so a sybil ring cannot audit itself. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 coins. An honest agent pays 20 coins and earns undiluted rewards.
